verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs directly claim funnel building alongside user segmentation ("Build funnels, segment users, answer 'why'"), and say users can jump from a funnel to the exact session. The evidence only names the capability: multi-step configuration, per-step filters, breakdowns and drop-off reporting are not described in any depth. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-step funnel construction, filter and breakdown controls, step-level drop-off/conversion metrics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can build multi-step funnels with filters and breakdowns to find where users drop off

citations.quote: Charts, dashboards, and insights. Build funnels, segment users, answer "why".
Go from a chart, funnel, or support ticket to the exact session.
